name: gmail-multi
description: Search, read, draft, and send across SEVERAL Gmail accounts at once — the managed Gmail connector binds to one account; this one covers them all in a single query, tags every result with its mailbox, fetches attachments, creates reviewable drafts, and can send, reply, and forward from whichever account you name (every send asks you to approve it, and is refused when nobody is present; consumers with a draft-only policy, like jobsearch, deny the send tools with their own guard). Every call names its account: one left unset is refused, so pass `all` to search every registered account. Standalone: configure accounts with its own /gmail-multi:accounts command; app passwords stay in the OS credential store and are never seen by Claude. Use it whenever mail spans more than one Google account.

metadata.versioningPolicy: Explicit releases; minor per behaviour change, patch per fix. Bump before any sync or push — an unbumped change ships nothing and looks like a broken install.
metadata.provides: MCP server gmail-multi (8 gmail_* tools: 5 read/draft + send/reply/forward). Registry: ~/.claude/gmail-multi/accounts.json schema 2 (read-only to consumers; its one writer is scripts/accounts.py). Contracts: adr-004-gmail-connector-extraction.md
